{{Weapon infobox | description = {{Flavor|This weapon is used to craft the legendary greatsword Eternity by combining it in the Mystic Forge with:
• Sunrise
• 5 Piles of Crystalline Dust
• 10 Philosopher's Stones}} | prefix = selectable | type = Greatsword | skin = Twilight (skin); Dusk (skin); Naegling (skin); Dusk Experiment (skin) | uslot = Superior Sigil of Leeching | level = 80 | salvage = none | rarity = Legendary | bound = Account use | collection = Legendary Weapon: Eternity | id = 30704 | gallery2 = Twilight stowed.jpg | gallery2-text = Stowed. | gallery3 = Twilight footfalls.jpg | gallery3-text = Twilight footsteps effect. }} [[Twilight]] is a [[Legendary weapon|legendary]] greatsword crafted in the [[Mystic Forge]]. It can be combined with its counterpart [[Sunrise]] to create [[Eternity]]. Unlocking the weapon in the [[Legendary Armory]] will grant the player a [[Memory of Twilight]]. == Lore == {{Legendary unlock text|While the other gods slept, [[Grenth]] took up his throne—beckoning his companions to dance and howl beneath the stars. It was said that his powers were most potent when the [[moon]] was highest in the sky.}} == Acquisition == === Contained in === {{contained in}} === Recipe === {{Recipe | source = Mystic Forge | quantity = 1 | ingredient1 = 1 Dusk | ingredient2 = 1 Gift of Twilight | ingredient3 = 1 Gift of Mastery | ingredient4 = 1 Gift of Fortune }} == Graphics == [[Twilight]] is a demonic greatsword whose blade can best be described as a window into space. The blade's flats are a painterly design whose texture shifts and rotates. Moving or swinging the blade leaves a painterly afterimage that also acts as a window into space. While drawn, the blade is surrounded with a soft aura that reflects its color; and white sparkles pop off the blade. ; Aura * The user's body is surrounded by darkness. * Small dark orbs rise from the user's body. ; Draw/Stow effects * When drawn, a burst of darkness emanates from the user's body. ; Footfalls * The user leaves behind painterly footprints that act as a window into space. ; Skill effects * Ranged skills will throw [[Twilight]] instead of the default projectile. This effect changes the following skills: ** {{g}} [[Guardian]]: {{Skill icon|Whirling Wrath}} and {{Skill icon|Binding Blade}}. *** {{dragonhunter}} [[Dragonhunter]]: {{Skill icon|Spear of Justice}}. ** {{w}} [[Warrior]]: {{Skill icon|Bladetrail}} and {{Skill icon|Throw Rock}} (downed skill). ** {{r}} [[Ranger]]: {{Skill icon|Throw Dirt}} (downed skill) . *** {{Soulbeast}} [[Soulbeast]]: any projectile from Soulbeast pet skills such as {{Skill icon|Narcotic Spores}}. ** {{m}} [[Mesmer]]: {{Skill icon|Mirror Blade}}. ** {{re}} [[Revenant]]: {{Skill icon|Essence Sap}} (downed skill). *** {{renegade}} [[Renegade]]: {{Skill icon|Citadel Bombardment}}. ** {{n}} [[Necromancer]]: *** {{harbinger}} [[Harbinger Shroud]]: {{Skill icon|Tainted Bolts}} and {{Skill icon|Dark Barrage}}. *** {{ritualist}} [[Ritualist]]: {{Skill icon|Essence Blast}} === Gallery === File:Twilight concept art.jpg|Concept art by [[Kekai Kotaki]].
